package robotaccess

import (
	sender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	roomlogic "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/room"
	domain "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/survival"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
)

// Dispatch 只转换协议；玩家身份与连接标识来自已鉴权会话（room.ConnectionKey），规则、时间、资源与权限仍由正式
// Nest handler 决定。Robot 只有 Play 一条消息，所以换连接后的席位接管（Kind "reconnect"）也经它转给 room 的
// RoomReconnect；真实客户端直接发 room 模块自带的 RoomReconnect 协议。
func Dispatch(engine *nest.NestMgr) gateway.TCPDispatch {
	business := sender.NewSurvivalExtractionSender(engine)
	reconnect := sender.NewRoomReconnectSender(engine)
	return func(ctx context.Context, session gateway.Session, id, seq uint32, kind wire.PayloadKind, data []byte) (any, error) {
		if id != msgid.MsgPlay || kind != wire.PayloadProtobuf {
			return nil, gateway.ErrInvalidRequest
		}
		request, err := pb.UnmarshalPlayRequest(data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		player := session.Principal().PlayerID
		connection, err := roomlogic.ConnectionKey(session)
		if err == nil {
			switch request.Kind {
			case "claim":
				_, err = business.MultiSync_SurvivalClaim(ctx, player, request.RoomID)
			case "reconnect":
				_, err = reconnect.Sync_RoomReconnect(ctx, request.RoomID, player, request.Epoch, connection)
			default:
				command := domain.Command{Seq: request.Seq, Epoch: request.Epoch, Kind: request.Kind, A: int(request.A), B: int(request.B)}
				_, err = business.Sync_SurvivalCommand(ctx, request.RoomID, player, connection, command)
			}
		}
		response := &pb.PlayResponse{Seq: request.Seq}
		if err != nil {
			response.Code = 1
		}
		payload, err := pb.MarshalPlayResponse(response)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &gateway.TCPResponse{MessageID: id, Sequence: seq, Payload: payload}, nil
	}
}
